title: Referral of the proposed Strategic Charging Infrastructure Scheme by the Office for Zero Emission Vehicles
content: The Subsidy Advice Unit (SAU) has published a report providing advice to the Office for Zero Emission Vehicles (OZEV) concerning its proposed Strategic Charging Infrastructure Scheme.
